prompt: A friend asks for honest feedback on a competition essay they love, but a key section is confusing and would likely cost them marks. What response is both kind and honest?

options.text: Say it is perfect as it is, because they worked hard and need confidence
Point to what works, name the confusing section specifically, and offer to help them rework that part
Tell them bluntly that section is terrible and they will probably lose if they keep it
Give vague praise like it is really good and hope they notice the problem themselves

explanation: Specific honesty helps them improve before the deadline, while vague praise or harsh bluntness either leaves the problem in place or knocks their confidence. Naming strengths as well keeps the feedback usable.
